In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
observed: 17.0 to 17.4 s, option b. The roof-deep car drifts left until it is cut by the left edge; wake, floating pieces and a jagged pale vertical line remain in the water. The pale tan band under the far bank stays straight and horizontal across the full width. Caption clears at 17.4 s. At 17.6 s a cut to a flooded residential street: beige houses, live oak, green street signs, a white sensor-roof car in brown water with a reflection, a dark grey shape at the right edge, and a tiled sidewalk foreground.
